result.reason: The operative language gives Licensee a 30-day written-notice convenience termination right and requires a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, which substantively provides the required pro-rata refund. Licensor receives no convenience termination right during the committed term. However, permitting termination “in whole or in part” exceeds the preferred position and creates avoidable uncertainty about how refunds apply to a partial termination. The unrelated typo correction is appropriate, and the remaining commercial terms are preserved.
